title: Perahu Kertas
subject: a paper boat in a monsoon drain
caption: Keroncong. The cak and cuk ukuleles play the interlocking off-beat pattern that defines the form, a cello plucked pizzicato on the downbeats, upright bass, flute taking the melody between vocal lines, and a guitar filling. A soft female alto sings breathy and restrained with the gentle portamento of keroncong, never loud. Tape saturation, close-miked, small room. 84 BPM, C major. Gentle, old-fashioned, patient.
lyrics:
[Intro - Cak & Cuk]

[Verse 1]
Hujan berhenti pukul lima
Air longkang jalan laju
Aku lipat kertas jadi perahu
Macam ayah ajar dulu

[Pre-Chorus]
Dia kata perahu kertas
Tak perlu sampai mana-mana

[Chorus]
Perahu kertas, pergi dulu
Aku tengok sampai kau hilang
Aku tak tahu kau ke mana
Itu pun sudah cukup

[Verse 2]
Ayah dah lama tak ada
Lipatan aku masih sama
Tangan aku dah besar
Kertas tetap kecil

[Flute Solo]

[Chorus]
Perahu kertas, pergi dulu
Aku tengok sampai kau hilang
Aku tak tahu kau ke mana
Itu pun sudah cukup

[Outro]
Pergi dulu
Pergi dulu
